crossRefs.note: They stripped him, and put a scarlet robe on him.
Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

translations.web: They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
translations.bsb: They dressed Him in a purple robe, twisted together a crown of thorns, and set it on His head.
